dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Oh, you even have these. These drums are the kuuhenki's favorite instruments.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I used to worry that they would get carried away and hurt themselves, but — as though to loudly drum away my concerns — they played even harder.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Can you teach me how to make them? I'm sure those children would be happy to receive one as a gift.
